Overall, Cherry Zashimi is a solid choice if you want a flavorful strain that gives you a happy, balanced high with a sweet twist. products.description: Click here for COA Jealousy strain is a well-balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) made by crossing two impressive strains: Gelato 41 and Sunset Sherbet. This earthy strain has exceptionally high THC levels, around 28-30%, and is perfect for experienced cannabis users. Jealousy THCa strain will bring an uplifting high that will relax you for hours. You’ll then feel creativity coming over you, energizing your brain with motivation to finish any task. On the comedown, you’ll feel a euphoric body high, leaving you happy and maybe giggly. Jealousy strain is a real standout for anyone who loves a potent, well-rounded high with a dash of luxury. This combo brings together the best traits of both parents, delivering a smooth and flavorful experience with a bit of an edge. Visually, Jealousy is striking. The buds are often dense and compact, covered in a thick layer of glistening trichomes that give them a frosty, almost diamond-like appearance. You’ll notice vibrant colors too, with shades of deep green, purple, and a touch of orange pistils that really pop. Aroma-wise, Jealousy is quite enticing. It has a rich, complex scent with strong notes of sweet, citrusy fruit, combined with hints of earthy and pine undertones. It’s like a fresh, fruity dessert with a touch of spice—inviting and intriguing. When it comes to flavor, Jealousy continues to impress. The taste is smooth and sweet, with a fruity, citrusy profile that might remind you of a sherbet or candy. There’s also a subtle earthy undertone that rounds out the flavor, making each puff delicious and satisfying. As for the effects, Jealousy delivers a balanced high that hits both your mind and body. You’ll start with an uplifting, euphoric buzz that boosts your mood and creativity, perfect for socializing or diving into creative projects. As the high progresses, you’ll experience a relaxing body effect that helps ease tension without making you too sleepy or couch-locked. Overall, Jealousy is a fantastic choice if you’re into strains that offer a rich flavor profile and a well-rounded high. It’s great for enhancing social experiences, winding down, or simply enjoying a flavorful smoke. If you’re looking for something that combines sweetness with a bit of sophistication, Jealousy is definitely worth a try! Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene Limonene Myrcene 21.7% THCa 3.5 Grams hybrid Hybrid THCa Flower prem

It is a cross between three notable strains: 707 Headband x Triangle Kush x SFV OG Kush. The breeders behind this strain are Ethos Genetics. The strain may also feature hints of purple or orange, adding to its visual appeal. Aroma/Flavor Quattro Kush exhibits a complex and enticing aroma derived from its parent strains. The scent is spicy and skunky, with hints of diesel inherited from the 707 Headband. The earthy scents of Triangle Kush help mellow out the overall aroma. At the same time, SFV OG Kush contributes fresher citrus and pine flavors. The flavor profile of Quattro Kush is a harmonious combination of various elements. products.description: Click here for COA This strain is pretty awesome if you're into potent and flavorful cannabis. It’s a Sativa-dominant hybrid strain. It is a cross between Martian Mean Green, known for its stimulating effects and fruity flavors, and Wedding Cake, loved for its relaxing effects and sweet, vanilla-like taste. With this combo, you’re looking at a nice blend of cerebral high and relaxing effects. Space Junky usually has a sweet, fruity aroma, kind of like berries with a hint of citrus. When you smoke it, you'll get a taste that matches that—think blueberries with a bit of earthy undertones. The high kicks in with a euphoric, uplifting vibe, which is great if you want to chill but still stay engaged and creative. It's perfect for kicking back with some friends, playing video games, or even tackling some creative projects. In terms of effects, it’s known for giving you a balanced high—initially, it’ll get your head buzzing and uplifted, but it doesn’t leave you couch-locked. As the high progresses, you might feel more relaxed and mellow, which makes it a good choice for both day and evening use. Overall, if you're looking for something that hits that sweet spot between relaxation and energy, Space Junky is definitely worth checking out. Terpenes Myrcene- This is often the dominant terpene in Space Junky. It has an earthy, musky aroma with hints of fruit. Myrcene is known for its sedative effects and can contribute to the strain’s relaxing, mellow vibe. It also helps in enhancing the overall high by promoting a more chill experience. Limonene- This terpene gives off a citrusy, lemony smell. Limonene is known for its uplifting and mood-enhancing effects. It can help boost your mood and provide a bit of energy, which complements the euphoric high of Space Junky. Pinene- With its fresh, piney scent, Pinene adds a bit of crispness to the aroma. This terpene is believed to have memory-enhancing and anti-inflammatory properties. It also balances out the high, providing a bit of mental clarity and focus. With these terpenes, Space Junky offers a nice blend of relaxation, mood enhancement, and mental clarity, making it a well-rounded strain for various activities.

products.description: Click here for COA Tres Leches is a strain that’s definitely worth checking out if you’re into tasty and potent flower. It’s a hybrid, usually a cross between Tres Dawg and a few other strains, which gives it a unique profile. The name might give you a clue—it’s named after the rich, sweet dessert, and that’s exactly what you’re getting. The strain has a creamy, dessert-like flavor with hints of vanilla and a touch of earthy spice. It’s smooth and sweet, making each toke feel like a treat. As for the effects, Tres Leches offers a balanced high. It starts with a nice, euphoric uplift that can get you feeling chatty and happy, which is great for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some good vibes. As the high progresses, it transitions into a more relaxed, mellow feeling. It’s not going to leave you glued to the couch, but it will definitely help you unwind and kick back. In terms of its therapeutic effects, Tres Leches can be great for managing stress or anxiety. It can help with relaxation without completely knocking you out, so you can still stay productive if you need to. It also tends to spark up an appetite, so if you’ve got the munchies, this strain’s got you covered. Overall, Tres Leches is a solid pick if you’re looking for a flavorful strain with a balanced high that’s both uplifting and relaxing. Terpenes Myrcene: This is usually a prominent terpene in Tres Leches. It has an earthy, musky aroma with hints of fruit, and it's known for its relaxing and sedative effects. Myrcene helps to give the strain its mellow, calming qualities and enhances the overall relaxing high. It also adds a bit of that creamy, smooth flavor to the profile. Limonene: With its bright, citrusy scent, Limonene adds a zesty, lemon-like flavor to Tres Leches. This terpene is known for its mood-enhancing properties and can give you a bit of a mental boost. It contributes to the uplifting and euphoric part of the high, making it feel more enjoyable and energizing. Caryophyllene: This terpene brings a spicy, peppery aroma and flavor to the mix. It’s unique because it can interact with the body’s cannabinoid receptors, offering potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving benefits. This strain is beloved for its energizing effects that keep you focused and motivated throughout the day. With a tangy, fruity flavor reminiscent of sweet mango, Green Crack is a daytime favorite for those looking to combat fatigue, stress, and low energy. Green Crack Strain Terpenes The terpene profile of Green Crack significantly contributes to its sensory appeal and effects: Myrcene : The most abundant terpene, it imparts an earthy, musky aroma, potentially enhancing the strain's relaxing yet uplifting effects. Caryophyllene: Offers a spicy, peppery note, enriching the flavor profile while possibly providing anti-inflammatory benefits. Pinene: Adds a refreshing pine scent, which may help with alertness and memory, counterbalancing the sedative qualities of Myrcene. These terpenes work together to create Green Crack's distinctive aroma and are key to its energizing and mood-enhancing properties. The strain's effects are cerebral, promoting a sense of well-being, creativity, and motivation, making it a go-to for those battling lethargy or mental fog. products.description: NOTE - This flower is from an earlier harvest and is discounted accordingly. What is Tricho Jordan THCa Flower Strain? Tricho Jordan THCa Flower Strain is a unique indica-leaning hybrid, meticulously bred through the cross of Chimera #2 and Chimera #3. This strain is renowned for its stunning appearance, featuring pale yellow trichomes that blanket its dark-bodied buds, creating a visually striking contrast. Tricho Jordan releases an aromatic fusion of vanilla yogurt and strawberries, with nuances of minty herbs emerging once the bud is ground. This inviting scent profile makes Tricho Jordan not just a pleasure to look at but also a delight to smell. Tricho Jordan Terpenes The terpene profile of Tricho Jordan is rich and vibrant, with caryophyllene, linalool, and humulene leading the aromatic charge. Caryophyllene imparts a spicy and woody undertone that complements the sweet fragrance of the bud, while linalool adds a floral and lavender touch, enhancing the strain’s soothing properties. Humulene contributes an earthy, hoppy aroma that rounds out the complexity of the profile. Together, these terpenes create a balanced and deeply pleasant olfactory experience that mirrors the strain’s rich flavors of high-end strawberry ice cream. Tricho Jordan Strain Cannabinoids THCA: 24.08% Total Cannabinoids: 25.32% D9-THC: 0.15% Tricho Jordan THCA Strain Effects Tricho Jordan offers a potent yet balanced set of effects, typical of an indica-dominant hybrid. It begins with an immediate relaxation that eases the body, releasing tension and stress, making it an ideal choice for unwinding at the end of a busy day. The initial relaxation deepens into a state of deep comfort, accompanied by a giddy elation that gradually evolves into soaring euphoria. The experience peaks with a controllable, satisfying stoned sensation that is profound enough to be thoroughly enjoyed yet not debilitating. Tricho Jordan is particularly suited for experienced cannabis users due to its strength, but novices can also appreciate it in moderation, making it a versatile choice for a broad range of consumers seeking a quality, feel-good bud. products.description: Strain Profile Banana Cream Pie THCA Flower is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from Banana OG crossed with Cookies and Cream . The cross delivers a richly dessert-leaning aromatic profile and dense, well-structured buds with the kind of trichome coverage that signals premium indoor cultivation — flavor-character first, eye appeal close behind. Effects Banana Cream Pie delivers a relaxing body high paired with a euphoric cerebral uplift. The onset is gradual and warm; the body settles fully into comfortable ease while the head stays mood-lifted — making this a strong evening cultivar for unwinding, post-work decompression, or settling in with food and a quiet space. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe banana up front, with creamy vanilla through the middle and a warm dough-and-sugar finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bakery-rich. The terpene profile reads banana-vanilla-and-dough — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Banana Cream Pie harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Banana Cream Pie THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Banana Cream Pie THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Bath Saltz THCA Flower is a hybrid that crosses Bubble Bath (The Soap × Project 4516) with Runtz (Zkittlez × Gelato). The genetics stack is essentially a greatest-hits of modern dessert lineage — and it shows in the bag: frosty, dense, candy-sweet flower with a clean structure and loud aromatic profile. Effects Bath Saltz tilts toward uplifted hybrid. Expect a euphoric, mood-lifting onset that settles into a comfortably focused baseline — the kind of high that improves your afternoon without taking it over. Long-lasting and steady, with enough cerebral energy for creative work and enough body ease to keep you out of your head. A versatile all-day pick. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: sugary candy and ripe fruit up front, with creamy vanilla layered underneath and a subtle earthy-pine note grounding the finish. Smoke is smooth, dessert-rich, and unmistakably Runtz-family in its terpene loudness. The flavor profile leans tropical-creamy — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Bath Saltz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. View the Bath Saltz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Bath Saltz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Biscotti THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid often credited to Gelato 25 × Sour Florida OG (with some sources citing Motorbreath × Gelato 41 ). Either way, the cultivar is a modern flavor cornerstone — dense buds, deep coloring, generous trichome coverage, and a sweet cookie-like aromatic profile that rewards every step from the jar to the exhale. Effects Biscotti delivers a sneaky cerebral journey that builds gradually before settling into a relaxed, inspired, body-buzzing baseline. The high doesn't announce itself loudly — it sneaks up — making this a cultivar to dose with respect, especially for users with low tolerance. Best paired with downtime or evening use. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet cookie-cream up front, with layered fuel undertones through the middle and a warm dessert finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and richly textured. The terpene profile reads cookie-and-gas with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Biscotti harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Biscotti THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Biscotti THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. 🥚 THCA: 22.512% Delta-9 THC: 0.2170% Cookie Cream indica Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Garlic Sauce THCA Flower is a powerhouse Indica-dominant hybrid that doesn’t hold back. Created by crossing GMO and Garlic Cookies, this strain is celebrated for its high cannabinoid content and its unmistakable "savory funk." The buds are dense, resinous, and coated in a thick layer of frosty trichomes, signaling the potency within. Effects Expect a heavy, full-body relaxation that sets in quickly. Garlic Sauce is perfect for the end of a long day when you need to "turn off" the noise. Users often report a deep sense of euphoria followed by a sedative physical calm, making it an ideal choice for evening use, relaxation, or deep sleep. Flavor & Aroma True to its name, Garlic Sauce hits the nose with a pungent blast of spicy garlic, earthy mushroom, and hints of sharp onion. Upon exhale, the flavor is surprisingly smooth with a lingering herbal sweetness and a woodsy finish. It is a bold, "loud" profile that seasoned connoisseurs will truly appreciate. Lab Tested — View the COA Garlic Sauce is third-party tested for cannabinoid content and product compliance. View the Garlic Sauce THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for the linked test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Gruntz THCA Flower is a flavor-led hybrid in the broader Runtz family that brings a heavier gassy edge to the classic candy-sweet profile. The cultivar produces dense, frost-coated buds with the kind of layered aromatic character that combines tropical fruit candy with a subtle fuel undertone. Effects Gruntz delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of contrasting character that distinguishes Runtz-gas crosses. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet tropical fruit up front, with sugary candy through the middle and a warm gas finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably layered. The terpene profile reads candy-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Gruntz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Gruntz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Gruntz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 22.875% Delta-9 THC: 0.2104% hybrid Sugar Sweet Tropical Fruit THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Gush Mintz THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid developed by Purple City Genetics in the Bay Area, crossing Kush Mints with F1 Durb and Gushers. The lineage stack delivers compact, deep-green and purple buds with generous trichome coverage and the pungent, sweet-pine aromatic profile that distinguishes this cultivar from typical mint hybrids. Effects Gush Mintz delivers a deeply relaxing experience anchored by full-body ease and warm cerebral euphoria. Onset is steady and the high lasts — suitable for evening use, post-work decompression, or any moment that benefits from real wind-down. A cultivar that earns its top-shelf reputation among indica fans. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: pungent sweetness up front, with cool minty pine through the middle and a grounding earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is full, layered, and richly textured. The terpene profile reads mint-and-pine with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Gush Mintz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Gush Mintz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Gush Mintz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Gushers THCA Flower is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from Gelato #41 and Triangle Kush . The genetics deliver dense, colorful buds — deep greens with purple expression and a trichome layer that holds the loud, candy-fruit terpene profile this strain is known for. Effects Gushers brings an easy, euphoric cerebral onset followed by a calming body baseline that doesn't fully sedate. The high feels balanced even with the indica lean — good for late-afternoon use, evening relaxation, or social situations where you want to stay present without buzzing. Steady and pleasant. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: tropical fruit and ripe berry up front, with a sweet, chewy candy middle and a sugary finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-leaning. The terpene profile reads fruit-forward with a creamy depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Gushers harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Gushers THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Gushers THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Jealousy THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Sherbert crossed with Gelato 41 . The cross delivers a richly dessert-leaning aromatic profile and dense, well-structured buds with deep color expression and generous trichome coverage — a connoisseur-leaning cultivar with broad flavor appeal. Effects Jealousy delivers a euphoric yet deeply relaxing experience. The cerebral side stays mood-lifting and pleasant; the body baseline settles into calm, easy relaxation rather than heavy sedation. A versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding without committing to a couch-locked night. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet creamy notes up front, with bright citrus through the middle and a warm earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-rich. The terpene profile reads cream-citrus-and-earth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Jealousy harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Jealousy THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Jealousy THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Zushi THCA Flower is a unique hybrid bred from the flavorful combination of Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cultivar captures attention with vibrant candy sweetness accented by refreshing minty notes, subtle earthiness, and delicate citrus undertones — producing dense, colorful buds with the kind of bag appeal that telegraphs flavor character. Effects Zushi delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of refreshing character that distinguishes this Zkittlez-mints cross. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: vibrant candy sweetness up front, with cool minty notes through the middle and a subtle earthy-citrus finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads candy-mint-and-citrus — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Lolliato Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Southern Oregon Private Farm The same Southern Oregon farm responsible for the Toad Venom phenotypes that earned Herb.co’s 2026 THCa Flower Strain of the Year developed Lolliato as a separate genetic direction entirely. Where Confetti Venom takes the Toad Venom foundation and adds dimension, Lolliato is the farm pursuing a different question: what does candy-forward Gelato-family genetics look like when the farm selects specifically for lollipop-candy character and grows it in a no-till living soil environment that amplifies terpene expression at every development stage? The name answers the question directly. Lolliato is the portmanteau of lollipop and Gelato — the specific candy format that is purely sweet, purely bright, and comes in colors that are themselves the flavor indicators. Gelato genetics, developed by the Cookies Fam collective from Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC, already carry the caryophyllene-limonene-linalool terpene combination that produces the creamy, sweet, dessert character the Gelato family is known for. The lollipop parent adds the bright, singular candy-sweet dimension that pushes the profile from dessert-rich toward something more immediately striking — the candy you find at the bottom of a bag that is somehow more intensely flavored than anything else in it. In living soil from the Southern Oregon farm, both the Gelato creamy depth and the lollipop candy brightness develop at full concentration. The linalool from the Gelato genetics — the floral-lavender compound that gives Gelato-family strains their smooth, rounded sweetness — accumulates more completely in the mycorrhizal root zone. The result is a terpene profile that is sweet-bright on top and creamy-dessert underneath, the candy and the cream running simultaneously rather than one following the other. This farm does not release strains it is not proud of. Lolliato is on the shelf because the Southern Oregon program earned it. Where Confetti Venom takes the Toad Venom foundation and adds dimension, Lolliato is the farm pursuing a different question: what does candy-forward Gelato-family genetics look like when the farm selects specifically for lollipop-candy character and grows it in a no-till living soil environment that amplifies terpene expression at every development stage? The name answers the question directly. Lolliato is the portmanteau of lollipop and Gelato — the specific candy format that is purely sweet, purely bright, and comes in colors that are themselves the flavor indicators. Gelato genetics, developed by the Cookies Fam collective from Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC, already carry the caryophyllene-limonene-linalool terpene combination that produces the creamy, sweet, dessert character the Gelato family is known for. The lollipop parent adds the bright, singular candy-sweet dimension that pushes the profile from dessert-rich toward something more immediately striking — the candy you find at the bottom of a bag that is somehow more intensely flavored than anything else in it. In living soil from the Southern Oregon farm, both the Gelato creamy depth and the lollipop candy brightness develop at full concentration. The linalool from the Gelato genetics — the floral-lavender compound that gives Gelato-family strains their smooth, rounded sweetness — accumulates more completely in the mycorrhizal root zone. The result is a terpene profile that is sweet-bright on top and creamy-dessert underneath, the candy and the cream running simultaneously rather than one following the other. Street Tarts Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Purple City Genetics built Street Tarts from Guava Tart and Street Guru, and the cross landed in a specific territory between tropical fruit candy and gas-forward pastry that most strains named after confectionery never actually reach. Guava Tart brings the guava funk and tropical tartness. Street Guru brings the street-level gas depth and the urban edge that the name implies. Together they produce something that is genuinely tart in the way fruit candy is tart rather than the way generic “candy” strains approximate it — the citrus and tropical notes have an actual sour bite before the sweetness resolves. The visual is what consumers consistently mention first. Glittering purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, with a trichome architecture dense enough to reflect light. The purple coloration develops from the genetics rather than temperature stress — it is an expression of the anthocyanin compounds in the Guava Tart genetics rather than a manipulation of the environment to force color. That distinction matters in living soil cultivation: the color is the plant’s own response to the genetics under conditions that support full secondary metabolite expression. The terpene profile runs tropical, gas, and pastry simultaneously — a nose that opens with guava and tropical citrus tartness, then shifts to the Street Guru gas depth, then settles on something warm and slightly doughy underneath. That progression is what earns the “tarts” reference: a candy that opens sweet-tart and resolves to something with body. Indica-leaning hybrid. Cerebral euphoria arriving first, body weight building. This is from our private Northern California small-batch program — limited quantity, grown in living soil, not a rotating catalog item. Blue Razz Eclair Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Two distinct flavor references compressed into one strain name. Blue Razz is the sharp, tart blue raspberry candy note — the candy color that is not actually a real fruit but has become one of the most immediately recognizable flavor identities in American confectionery. An eclair is a pastry: choux dough exterior, cream filling, chocolate glaze. The combination in a strain name is doing something specific. Not “Blue Razz” with sweetness behind it. Blue Razz with a cream-filled pastry depth behind it. The tartness is the front. The eclair is what you find underneath. The Blue Razz family traces through Blue Cookies and Mendobreath UV and through Raspberry Kush-adjacent genetics to a Blueberry-descended foundation that gives the blue family its characteristic dark berry and blueberry depth. The specific Blue Razz Eclair expression adds the pastry and cream character to that foundation — a Cookies or Gelato-adjacent cross adding the doughy-sweet depth that turns a sharp berry candy profile into a dessert experience with layers. Berry above cream above dough. The specific tart sour note that makes blue raspberry candy immediately recognizable, resolved by a cream-filled finish. Indica-leaning hybrid. The berry brightness of the Blue Razz lineage delivers the initial mood elevation while the eclair-adjacent pastry genetics ground it in a settled, comfortable body experience. Not a racy sativa despite the bright candy opening. The opening is the sour blue raspberry hit. What it resolves into is the full eclair. From our private Northern California small-batch farm. Living soil. Limited quantity. Blue Razz Eclair Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Two distinct flavor references compressed into one strain name. Blue Razz is the sharp, tart blue raspberry candy note — the candy color that is not actually a real fruit but has become one of the most immediately recognizable flavor identities in American confectionery. An eclair is a pastry: choux dough exterior, cream filling, chocolate glaze. The combination in a strain name is doing something specific. Not “Blue Razz” with sweetness behind it. Blue Razz with a cream-filled pastry depth behind it. The tartness is the front. The eclair is what you find underneath. The Blue Razz family traces through Blue Cookies and Mendobreath UV and through Raspberry Kush-adjacent genetics to a Blueberry-descended foundation that gives the blue family its characteristic dark berry and blueberry depth. The specific Blue Razz Eclair expression adds the pastry and cream character to that foundation — a Cookies or Gelato-adjacent cross adding the doughy-sweet depth that turns a sharp berry candy profile into a dessert experience with layers. Berry above cream above dough. The specific tart sour note that makes blue raspberry candy immediately recognizable, resolved by a cream-filled finish. Indica-leaning hybrid. The berry brightness of the Blue Razz lineage delivers the initial mood elevation while the eclair-adjacent pastry genetics ground it in a settled, comfortable body experience. Not a racy sativa despite the bright candy opening. The opening is the sour blue raspberry hit. What it resolves into is the full eclair. From our private Northern California small-batch farm. Living soil. Limited quantity. When they named Blue Lobster the THCa Flower Strain of the Year for 2025 , they were not reviewing a press release. They were reviewing the flower. Read the Honeysuckle Magazine feature here. Apples and Bananas crossed with Eye Candy — both from Compound Genetics, one of the most respected boutique breeding programs in the California market. Apples and Bananas is itself a four-way cross of Platinum Cookies, Gelato 41, Apple Fritter, and Blue Power, producing a complex multi-terpene profile that leans sweet and fruity with a gas depth underneath. Eye Candy, a cross of Jealousy and Runtz, adds the candy sweetness, the Gelato-family creaminess, and the balanced hybrid effect that makes the combination work across different sessions and different consumers. Blue Lobster is what Compound Genetics produced when both parents were expressing their most interesting terpene characters in the same phenotype selection. Read the full blue lobster strain guide The visual is where the name becomes obvious. Forest green nugs with deep indigo and violet undertones — not purple-adjacent, but genuinely blue-toned in certain light conditions, the specific indigo that makes Blue Lobster photographs immediately recognizable on social media. Bright orange pistils weaving through the indigo-green structure. A heavy frost of translucent crystals that the Gelato 41 and Runtz genetics in the lineage consistently drive to extreme density. Kenny P described the nose alongside Skunk #1: both wild, strong nose, great taste. Loyd H called it his favorite strain from Sherlocks. Shawn H — usually an indica person — said this one hits. Birthday Cake Strain THCa Flower – Light Assist Private SoCal Farm Birthday Cake originated at Kind Love dispensary in Denver in 2014 under the name Pink Cookies before arriving in Colorado with its current name. Cannarado Genetics popularized it as Birthday Cake S1 — a cross between two crosses, GSC x Cherry Pie run back against itself, stacking the dessert character from both parents at twice the concentration. The genetics are a direct ancestor of Wedding Cake and the entire dessert-Cookies lineage that defines the current premium hybrid market. This is the strain that the more famous cousins came from. The flavor profile lives up to the name in a specific rather than approximate way. The caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpene combination that Cherry Pie and GSC together produce creates a nose of sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting — the specific frosting quality that linalool’s floral warmth adds to the caryophyllene’s spiced depth, sitting above the limonene citrus brightness that keeps the dessert profile from being purely heavy. It tastes like birthday cake the food rather than birthday cake the concept, which is rarer than it sounds in a market full of dessert-named strains that deliver generic sweetness. The effects follow the same structure as the genetics: the GSC side produces the immediate euphoric mood uplift and the social ease, the Cherry Pie side grounds it in a settled indica body ease that builds through the session toward deep physical relaxation. The opening is celebratory. The finish is comfortable. The indica 60/40 lean means this session ends on the couch rather than at the party, which is the appropriate arc for a strain named after the best part of the party. Blue Dream Strain THCa Flower – Indoor Private Southern California Farm Blue Dream does not need an origin story at this point. The Blueberry x Haze cross from Santa Cruz is the most recognized sativa-dominant hybrid in American cannabis history — the strain that turned the California market toward fruit-forward sativa genetics in the mid-2000s and that has remained one of the most searched, most purchased, and most requested genetics in every legal market it has entered since. If you have been smoking cannabis long enough to have a reference point for what a sativa should feel like, Blue Dream is probably in that reference. The question is not what Blue Dream is. The question is where it comes from and how it was grown. DJ Short’s Blueberry — itself the Afghani x Purple Thai x Highland Thai cross that the cannabis community has considered one of the most important indica genetics since its release — contributes the blueberry sweetness and the indica body ease that prevents Blue Dream from being purely cerebral. The Haze parent contributes the sharp sativa energy, the creative uplift, and the citrus brightness that defines the sativa experience when Haze genetics are grown and expressed correctly. In indoor cultivation at our private Southern California farm, both contributions are present rather than one dominating. The blueberry sweetness is specific — DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce a more vivid and specific berry character than most Blueberry-named genetics available online because the lineage is documented and the cultivation environment supports full terpene expression. The Haze sativa energy is the functional, creative, clear-headed lift that made Blue Dream the go-to daytime strain for a decade before the exotic genetics market arrived and that still makes it the correct answer when someone specifically wants a classic California sativa experience rather than the newest candy cross. This is the Indoor tier — quality California indoor cultivation rather than the living soil AAA program. Blue Nerds Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Blue Nerds is one of those strains that creates a problem for the people selling it. The visual is so immediately arresting — deep grape-shaped buds, purple and blue coloration running through dense forest green, trichomes so thick they catch light from across a room — that the first thing every customer does is reach for the jar. The second thing they do is smell it and realize the visual wasn’t even the point. Sweet blueberry candy opens immediately. Tart citrus builds underneath. Then Granny Smith apple arrives — sharp and bright and not at all what the name prepared you for — and suddenly you understand why Global Genetics LA introduced this at Spannabis 2024 to the response it received. This is a candy terpene profile built on Runtz and Zkittlez genetics, which means the sweetness has depth rather than just surface. It doesn’t smell like a candy aisle. It smells like the specific piece of candy you remember eating as a child that you’ve been trying to find again ever since. The living soil cultivation is doing specific work here that is worth understanding. Blue Nerds carries a strong tendency toward purple and blue anthocyanin expression, and anthocyanin development responds to temperature cycling in ways that living soil cultivation naturally facilitates. A living soil bed — because of the thermal mass of its organic matter and microbiology — holds temperature more consistently than synthetic media but produces more natural day-to-night temperature variation than controlled indoor environments. That variation is what triggers the deepest purple expression in this genetics. The Blue Nerds in a living soil bed purple more completely and more evenly across the canopy than the same genetics in coco or rockwool. The visual that makes people reach for the jar is not incidental. It is what living soil does to this plant specifically. Cereal Milk Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Kam T put it plainly: the cereal n milk is one of her favorites. Nice body and head high, not too strong, just right. Sweet aroma. Pleasant taste. Not too harsh. She will definitely purchase again. That review is the brief. Cereal Milk is not a strain for the consumer who wants the most intense experience in the catalog. It is the strain for the consumer who wants something that delivers on its description precisely and without demanding anything complicated in return. The name is accurate in the way that the best strain names are accurate — not a loose reference to a general flavor category but the specific sensory experience of the sweetened milk left in the bowl after the cereal is gone. Slightly sweet. Slightly creamy. Slightly artificial in the specific way that breakfast cereal sweetness is slightly artificial. Not vanilla. Not just cream. The combination that exists in that specific context and nowhere else. Cookies Fam developed Cereal Milk from Sour Dubb and Y-Life — a Girl Scout Cookies phenotype that brought the creamy dough depth, and a Sour Diesel-adjacent cross that contributed the subtle diesel funk running under the sweetness. The combination is what prevents the cereal milk character from being purely sweet — there is a savory diesel undertone at the base that makes the cream note read as complex rather than just pleasant. The pale lime green buds with lavender hues and vivid orange pistils are the Cookies-family visual that this genetics reliably produces. Read the full cereal milk strain guide The light assist cultivation is the right environment for Cereal Milk’s terpene profile specifically because the linalool and myrcene combination that produces the creamy sweetness responds better to variable light exposure than to flat artificial spectrum. The creamy note in Cereal Milk — the specific character Kam T described as pleasant and not harsh — develops more completely under the natural spectrum variation of greenhouse cultivation. Indoor-only Cereal Milk tends to read as sweet and one-dimensional. The greenhouse version has the cream and the subtle diesel depth present simultaneous

Platinum White x Cookies and Cream produces a terpene profile where vanilla, coffee, and cream arrive together rather than one at a time — the specific combination that Oreo Double Stuff delivers when you eat it before you see it. Not just sweet. Not just creamy. The layered thing. Platinum White, itself a cross of Platinum Kush and The White, contributes the extreme trichome production architecture — The White’s trichome amplification genetics working on the Platinum Kush’s potency foundation to produce the dense crystal coating that makes Platinum White-lineage strains visually distinctive. The White has almost no terpene profile of its own, which means it amplifies whatever the other parent is doing rather than competing with it. The indoor cultivation is what keeps the vanilla and coffee terpene expression intact through the post-harvest process. Both compounds — the linalool that produces the vanilla sweetness and the myrcene-caryophyllene combination that produces the coffee depth — are sensitive to temperature variation in the drying room. Precise indoor humidity management from harvest through cure preserves both simultaneously, which is why the Double Stuffed name holds up when you open the jar rather than just describing what the breeder was reaching toward. Lemon Custard Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA The lemon dessert category has been one of the fastest-growing segments of the current cannabis market, and most of it lands in one of two directions: either lemon-forward with a generic sweet background, or dessert-forward with a lemon note that disappears quickly. Lemon Custard is the version that holds both simultaneously rather than sacrificing one for the other — the custard character, the warm egg-and-vanilla depth that actual custard produces, sitting beneath a bright lemon peel top note that remains specific and vivid rather than fading into generic citrus. Lemon Custard’s lineage traces to a Lemon Tree or Lemon Skunk-adjacent parent crossed with a Cookies-family or Gelato-family dessert contributor — the specific pairing that multiple breeders have converged on independently because it is the combination most likely to produce the custard character rather than just lemon-sweet or just creamy-dessert. The Lemon Tree heritage carries a specific limonene-plus-myrcene combination that produces the bright-and-grounded citrus quality — not sharp and clean like pure limonene, but warm and slightly earthy in a way that reads as the lemon in a baked custard rather than fresh-squeezed juice. The Cookies or Gelato contribution adds the vanilla and cream base that the custard name requires. What makes Lemon Custard worth growing in living soil specifically is the myrcene component. The warm, earthy depth that distinguishes the lemon custard character from generic lemon sweetness comes from the myrcene expression in the Lemon Tree-adjacent genetics — and myrcene, as documented across multiple strains in this program, develops more completely in living soil environments where the soil biology is supporting the full secondary metabolite expression rather than just the dominant limonene fraction. The citrus is present in any cultivation environment. The custard warmth that justifies the name is what the living soil is producing. Maui Wowie Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Michael got his order in about five days, tried the Maui Wowie alongside the White Widow, and was not let down compared to other vendors he had tried online. That review matters specifically because Michael named the strain — he was not reviewing the store in general or a different product, he was reviewing Maui Wowie specifically and decided it delivered. Maui Wowie has been in circulation since the 1970s. Hawaiian sativa landrace genetics, developed on the islands before most of the American cannabis market existed, selected over decades for the specific tropical fruit and citrus terpene profile and the clear, energetic, altitude-friendly high that became one of the most widely referenced cannabis experiences in the country. It has been imitated, diluted, and misrepresented on menus more than almost any other classic sativa. When it is the real genetics and it is grown correctly, the pineapple and mango note is specific and immediate — not tropical-adjacent, not citrus-forward with fruit described as tropical, but the actual Hawaiian sativa character that the original cultivars produced. Stephanie tried this batch and described a light fresh tropical smell and taste, then a hit of candy, then mint — ending in what she called eventual nirvana via a progression through calm, giggles, deep peace, and sustained tranquility throughout the body. That three-note terpene progression from tropical to candy to mint is the terpinolene expression from the Hawaiian genetics doing exactly what it evolved to do when it is given the cultivation conditions to develop fully. The light assist greenhouse is the correct environment for Maui Wowie for a reason that goes beyond the general light-assist-for-sativa explanation. Hawaiian landrace genetics evolved at altitude in the tropics — high UV exposure, warm days, cool nights, the full solar spectrum without moderation. These genetics do not respond to artificial-only spectrum the way continental sativa genetics do. They were bred for sun and they perform best when sun is part of the equation. The UV component of the greenhouse environment triggers terpinolene and ocime

Pineapple Express Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Seth Rogen and James Franco made Pineapple Express a household name in 2008. Before the film, it was a well-regarded sativa-dominant hybrid grown primarily in Hawaii and California. After the film, every cannabis operation in the country had something on the menu called Pineapple Express, and most of it had no meaningful relationship to the actual Trainwreck x Hawaiian genetics that produced the original. Carlo R called it a classic that stays in the test of time. He is right, and the cultural moment the film created is part of why — but the genetics are the deeper reason. Trainwreck x Hawaiian is a cross of two sativa-dominant genetics with genuinely complementary terpene profiles. Trainwreck, the Humboldt County three-way of Mexican Sativa, Thai Sativa, and Afghani Indica, brings the fast-acting cerebral energy, the spice and earthy lemon-lime depth, and the structural foundation. Hawaiian landrace genetics — the same source material that gave Maui Wowie its reputation — bring the tropical pineapple and citrus sweetness, the long-lasting uplifting sativa effect, and the specific Hawaiian terroir terpene expression that makes tropical fruit cannabis strains smell like actual tropical fruit rather than candy approximations. The combination produces the strain that the film was named after: sweet tropical pineapple on top, earthy spice from the Trainwreck depth underneath, a long-lasting energetic and creative high that made it the strain two people in a film about friendship and weed would chase across Los Angeles. The film made the name famous. The genetics made it worth keeping famous. Living soil is doing something specific with the Hawaiian landrace genetics in this cross. Hawaiian sativa genetics evolved outdoors with real UV exposure and complex soil biology — the same conditions that Maui Wowie requires and that we have discussed across every Hawaiian-lineage strain in the program. The pineapple and tropical fruit character in Hawaiian genetics responds to soil microbiology in ways that synthetic nutrient programs consistently underachieve. The living soil cultivation amplifies

Pure Michigan Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA ThugPug Genetics and 3rd Coast Genetics are both based in Michigan. When they collaborated on Pure Michigan they were not just naming a strain after geography — they were making a claim about what Michigan cannabis breeding had become by the time this cross was developed. Oreoz crossed with Mendo Breath F2. Oreoz itself a Cookies N Cream x Secret Weapon cross with the cookie-and-cream dessert depth and the potency ceiling that made it one of the most sought-after Cookies-adjacent genetics of the last decade. Mendo Breath F2 — the stabilized second-generation selection that ThugPug had already used in Peanut Butter Breath — contributing the heavy frost, the earthy vanilla-caramel depth, and the deeply relaxing indica body effect that Mendo Breath genetics consistently deliver. The combination produced a strain that looked unlike most of what was on the market and tasted more complex than the visual suggested it would. The visual is the first thing. Dense, heavily frosted buds that one reviewer described as a storm cloud dipped in diamonds — an overstatement that lands correctly because the trichome density on Pure Michigan at full development is genuinely unusual. The frost is not distributed evenly across the surface in the way that most high-THC genetics produce it. It accumulates in layers, the older trichomes slightly amber at the base and the newer development building on top in clear crystal. The effect of looking at a well-grown Pure Michigan bud in direct light is specific and immediately memorable. The aroma is where the Michigan claim lands. Chocolate, coffee, nutty spice, and creamy vanilla with hints of citrus and diesel depending on the cut and cure. Not a single dominant note but a layered profile that builds as the jar warms — the vanilla and caramel arriving first from the Mendo Breath genetics, then the Oreoz cookie depth, then a sharp citrus-lime note from the limonene that cuts through the warmth and makes the whole profile more complex than any single descriptor captures. Strawberry Cough Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Kyle Kushman developed Strawberry Cough from a Strawberry Fields cutting he received from a grower in Connecticut in 2000, crossed with an unknown Haze. The story goes that the first time he smoked it, the strawberry sweetness hit so intensely that it made him cough before he even exhaled. The name came from that experience rather than from marketing. The name has held up for twenty-five years because the experience it describes is real and consistent across grows when the genetics are handled correctly. Strawberry Cough actually smells and tastes like fresh strawberries — not strawberry candy, not strawberry-adjacent fruit, but the specific fresh-picked berry character that Kushman’s Strawberry Fields genetic contribution produces in the cross. The Haze genetics add the cerebral energy, the slight spice on the exhale, and the expansive sativa effect profile that prevented Strawberry Cough from being a novelty strain and made it a lasting one. The cough is the Haze expansion in the lungs meeting the sweet strawberry terpene intensity. Both are real. Both are the strain. The indoor cultivation is the appropriate environment for Strawberry Cough specifically because the strawberry terpene character — the limonene and ocimene combination that produces the fresh berry quality — is among the most volatile in the cannabis library. Indoor temperature precision from harvest through cure is what keeps the fresh strawberry note in the jar rather than allowing it to off-gas during a variable post-harvest process. The sweetness that makes this strain immediately recognizable requires careful handling to survive from harvest to consumption. John M found Strawberry Cough on the Sherlocks menu alongside Panama Red, Purple Haze, and Durban Poison. He noted he cannot wait to try the rest of the list. He has been waiting for places that keep old school genetics alive. Strawberry Cough is a different vintage from the landrace strains on that list but it represents the same commitment — a strain worth growing because it delivers something specific and genuine, not because it is commercially convenient. Two fruit-forward indicas, both known for sweetness and relaxation, combined into a strain that tastes like watermelon candy. And it does. The nose on Watermelon Z is immediately and unmistakably watermelon — not an approximation of watermelon, not watermelon-adjacent, but the specific candy-sweet, slightly musky, ripe-fruit smell that makes you reach for a second sniff before you have finished processing the first one. _*]:min-w-0 gap-3"> What makes Watermelon Z more interesting than its straightforward description suggests is the Zkittlez contribution. Zkittlez genetics carry a terpene architecture built around multiple distinct fruit notes layered on top of each other, which means the watermelon note in this cross sits above a tropical fruit depth that keeps the profile from being one-dimensional. There is mango and citrus underneath the watermelon. There is a slight earthy spice from the OG lineage running beneath that. The candy note is the loudest thing in the jar but it is not the only thing. _*]:min-w-0 gap-3"> The light assist cultivation is doing specific work here worth understanding. Watermelon Z’s fruit terpene expression — specifically the compounds responsible for the melon-candy character — develops most fully under conditions that include real UV light exposure. Artificial spectrum can replicate most of what natural light does to cannabis, but the UV component of direct sunlight triggers secondary metabolite production in ways that full indoor grows cannot match at comparable cost. The Watermelon OG genetics carry a strong response to UV exposure — the trichome development, the anthocyanin expression, and the fruit terpene loudness all respond to real sunlight in ways that show up clearly in this crop. The greenhouse environment provides that UV exposure consistently without the environmental variability of full outdoor cultivation. For a strain whose primary appeal is its terpene character, the grow method is not incidental. It is part of why the watermelon actually smells like watermelon. _*]:

Yum Berry Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Also known as: Blueberry Yum Yum Blueberry Yum Yum has a name that predates the strain. Ludacris released the song in 2001, named after the specific sweet blueberry candy character that DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce when they are grown correctly — a flavor reference so specific and so recognizable that it became cultural vocabulary before anyone formalized it as a strain name. The strain named itself after the song, or the song named itself after the flavor, depending on which version of the story you prefer. Either way, when the genetics actually deliver on the name, the reference makes immediate sense. Blueberry x Durban Poison is a cross we carry in two expressions — Bali Berry and Yum Berry — because the same genetic combination produces meaningfully different phenotype expressions depending on which parent’s character dominates. Bali Berry leans toward the Durban Poison’s tropical-island brightness — the terpinolene and ocimene expression that produces the lychee-mango-adjacent complexity that distinguishes the strain from standard berry crosses. Yum Berry leans toward the Blueberry side — the linalool-forward DJ Short expression that produces the specific sweet blueberry candy note the song and the strain are both named after. Same genetics, different phenotype selection, genuinely different terpene experience. The Yum Berry phenotype was selected specifically for the Blueberry Yum Yum character — the concentrated, slightly artificial-sweet blueberry that the linalool-dominant Blueberry expression produces at its most extreme. This is not fresh blueberry or blueberry jam. It is the specific candy version of blueberry that appears in the Blueberry genetics when the linalool accumulation reaches a certain threshold. Thomas Watson described a happy, euphoric high that tastes great and looks great. That combination — the candy-sweet terpene profile producing a euphoric balanced experience — is exactly what the Blueberry Yum Yum phenotype selection was designed to deliver. The living soil cultivation does specific work with the DJ Short Blueberry genetics that is worth understanding.
